locations.name: Patrón Lunares
locations.description: Proper Mallorcan plates served in a restyled old fishermen's club in Santa Catalina — frito mallorquín, tumbet, sobrassada with honey, snails, market fish — on Carrer de la Fàbrica a few doors from Xoriguer. Opens the tapas-crawl plan (cluster 1 with the Bar Cuba rooftop) and doubles as the backup if Toque de Queda is slammed. ⚠️ Chelsea note: the signature plates lean pork (frito, sobrassada) — the tumbet and fish dishes are her lane. 🚶 14 min from the Palma Riad.
locations.address: Carrer de la Fàbrica, 30, 07013 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Tapas-crawl backup: 'proper Mallorcan plates in an old fishermen's club' — use if Toque de Queda is slammed. Santa Catalina, ~10 min west of the crawl.

locations.name: Forn del Santo Cristo
locations.description: Historic Palma bakery (est. 1910) on Carrer de Paraires — ensaïmadas in every size plus crema-filled variants, boxed for carrying home. Filed in the tapas-crawl plan as the late-night ensaïmada finisher if open, with Ca'n Joan de S'Aigo the next-morning alternative; also the practical buy-the-airport-box stop before the Monday flight. 🚶 2 min from the Palma Riad.
locations.address: Carrer dels Paraires, 2, Centre, 07001 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Crawl finisher: 'a late-night ensaïmada from Forn del Santo Cristo if it's open, otherwise Ca'n Joan de S'Aigo the next morning.'

locations.name: Mercat de l'Olivar
locations.description: Palma's big covered market since the 1950s — Balearic cheeses, olives, local salts, plus eat-in stalls: Mercat Negre for fresh-seafood small plates and Buades for ibérico and charcuterie; also where the Cooking Class Soqueta market tour begins. The crawl-note move: buy prawns or fish from a stall and have the adjacent bar grill it for a few euros, or sit at the oyster-and-cava counter — a 45-minute standing lunch, not a sit-down meal. Morning-to-mid-afternoon rhythm (a Thursday 1 PM arrival is the tail end); known to run into the evening Fridays and Saturdays — verify on the day, since Friday pre-Stagier or Saturday pre-Sóller may be the better slot. 🚶 12 min from the Riad.
locations.address: Plaça de l'Olivar, s/n, 07002 Palma, Illes Balears, Spain

references.note: Market strategy: stall-to-bar grilling, oyster-and-cava counter, 45-minute standing lunch; morning place — Thu 1 PM is the tail end; reportedly open Fri/Sat evenings, verify on the day.
